description: California SNAP canonical two-person household on the corpus-direct CDSS composition.
notes: Canonical values are monthly. Inputs use the package-native slot names (snap_gross_monthly_earned_income, household_shelter_costs_incurred).

The California corpus-direct composition rounds the excess shelter deduction to whole dollars, like Colorado: net income is 226 where PolicyEngine keeps cents (226.5). See the Colorado case's rulespec-us#1167 note; the fifty-cent net-income delta does not move the 478 allotment.
